name: Ren

identity.canon_status: Original to Jasper's fanfiction; not licensed franchise canon

personality.voice: Underwritten in existing chapters; future scenes should let Ren speak directly about availability and tea-shop work rather than become a silent schedule example.
personality.agency: An employee's wages and rest are not gifts from Iroh; Mina organizes shifts and Iroh approves his share of the expense.

relationships.Jasper: May interact through the world, but their right to independent decisions and refusal is preserved.

unknowns: Pronouns, age, family and exact job title are not independently established.
Never treat a day off as a reward for romantic service.
Distinguish Ren from unrelated franchise characters of the same name.
authoring_rules: Do not invent unobserved personal history.
Preserve first-person limits on Jasper's knowledge.
Use real work, costs, refusal and individual motives in dialogue.
